new_assertions.title: source residual refinement is not necessary for the shortest local scalar repair
new_assertions.body: Although source quotient node 197000 merges represented residual-distinct fine sheets, the shortest scalar constraint system is satisfiable after splitting only the target while leaving source quotient node 197000 unchanged; source-sheet residual refinement is therefore not necessary for this local repair.

new_assertions.title: shortest-witness state-refinement repair is target-asymmetric
new_assertions.body: Under unchanged routes, edge deltas, and scalar Boolean codomain, every state-refinement-only repair of the shortest witness must separate the two fine target states, while at least one satisfying repair leaves the represented source merge unchanged.
